statement:
∀ (s C : ℝ) (A : KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff), (∀ f f' g g' h h' : KdVPlan.Coeff,
 KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s f' → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s g' → KdVPlan.MemH s h → KdVPlan.MemH s h' →
 A (f-f') g h = A f g h-A f' g h ∧ A f (g-g') h = A f g h-A f g' h ∧ A f g (h-h') = A f g h-A f g h') → (∀ f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s h → KdVPlan.HB 0 (A f g h) (C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s g*KdVPlan.hn s h)) →
 ∀ f f' g g' h h' : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s f' → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s g' → KdVPlan.MemH s h → KdVPlan.MemH s h' →
 KdVPlan.HB 0 (A f' g' h'-A f g h)
 (C*KdVPlan.hn s (f'-f)*KdVPlan.hn s g'*KdVPlan.hn s h' +
 C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s (g'-g)*KdVPlan.hn s h' +
 C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s g*KdVPlan.hn s (h'-h))
proof:
intro s C A hs hb f f' g g' h h' hf hf' hg hg' hh hh'
have hdf := (@yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s f' f hf' hf).1
have hdg := (@yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s g' g hg' hg).1
have hdh := (@yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s h' h hh' hh).1
have b₁ := hb (f'-f) g' h' hdf hg' hh'
have b₂ := hb f (g'-g) h' hf hdg hh'
have b₃ := hb f g (h'-h) hf hg hdh
have h₁ := (hs f' f g' g h' h hf' hf hg' hg hh' hh).1
have h₂ := (hs f f g' g h' h hf hf hg' hg hh' hh).2.1
have h₃ := (hs f f g g h' h hf hf hg hg hh' hh).2.2
have he : A f' g' h'-A f g h = (A (f'-f) g' h'+A f (g'-g) h')+A f g (h'-h) := by
 rw [h₁,h₂,h₃]
 abel
rw [he]
have ha := @yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 _ _ b₁.1 b₂.1
have hb' := @yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 _ _ ha.1 b₃.1
exact ⟨hb'.1, hb'.2.trans (add_le_add (ha.2.trans (add_le_add b₁.2 b₂.2)) b₃.2)⟩
